records: Coinbase's Q3 2026 filing does not identify the counterparty responsible for 27% of Q3 revenue. No relationship to Circle, Ripple, a market maker or XRP may be inferred without new evidence.
Circle Mint minted/redeemed totals are limited to Circle Mint customer fiat conversions; they are not total USDC supply changes, all exchange flows or XRP capital flows.

Circle's Circle Reserve Fund and bank-cash disclosures describe reserve composition, not stress-tested redemption behavior. No impairment, reserve loss or redemption failure is established; USDC-holder liabilities are not FDIC insured.

T54's x402 aggregate dashboard is operator-reported, multi-asset and not independently reconciled to validated XRPL transaction IDs. The implied USD0.00285 average is conditional on matching scopes; asset mix and repeat economic counterparties remain unknown.

PR #1371 is draft and unmerged. Its 30-day artifacts are not a durable feature store; exact-head core CI and fail-closed gate passed, but full repository CI was not run and the change is not active on main.
